protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed independently. In performDetectPublicKeyAlgorithms(), a leading-whitespace RSA PEM fails the ^-anchored publicKeyPemMatcher; absent an X.509 header, the key falls through to hsAlgorithms, allowing an HS256 token HMAC-signed with the public-key string to pass algorithm autodetection. A direct Node assertion reproduced parent includes() tolerance, BIC/later-regex failure with leading whitespace, and recovery after trim().
